explanation: From main: the verification workflow says to commit regenerated author-validation records with any ledger edit and names the freshness test. authorValidationFreshness.test.ts fails in CI when validation-records.generated.json disagrees with its ledgers or the inputSha256 the builder records; its three checks are marked it.fails until the 2026-10-25 records are regenerated, and the regenerating commit must change them back to it. The README and verification workflow say so. From this branch: explorerStore.ts splits its one error banner into a resource half (metadata, QC) and a track half, so a track load clears only a track failure when it starts and a metadata or QC failure keeps its Retry. Evidence, gates and producers are unchanged.
